convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for NonLagDot indicator and includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management and money management, requiring manual recreation of both custom indicator logic and trade execution helpers.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timing
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup
Fi - filter value converted to price units
derived_values.used_by: declared but unused in EA logic (possibly used internally by NonLagDot)

other_exits: When both SellPosOpen and SellPosClose are enabled and previous bar trend was 2 (sell), close sell on buy signal; same symmetric logic for buy close on sell signal when BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input (0.1) serves as either lot size or fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic: NonLagDot buffer 1 returns trend state values (1=up, 2=down). Buy signal when trend changes from 2 to 1 (TrendValue[0]==1 && TrendValue[1]==2). Sell signal when trend changes from 1 to 2 (TrendValue[0]==2 && TrendValue[1]==1). SignalBar input controls which bar is read (default=1, previous completed bar). When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. Additional close logic: if both open and close flags are enabled for a direction and the prior bar was already in that trend, a close signal is generated alongside the reversal open signal. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can independently disable long entries, short entries, short closes, and long closes respectively.
python_conversion_notes: The NonLagDot custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The TrendValue buffer returns discrete states (1=uptrend, 2=downtrend), so the crossover logic is actually a state transition detector. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and CIsNewBar - all must be reimplemented. The CIsNewBar class handles new bar detection. The MarginMode enum and its five sizing modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) need full implementation. SL/TP are in points (not pips), passed directly to the trade functions. Signal timing uses UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculated from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, which likely controls order expiration or slippage windows in the TradeAlgorithms library.
